messages.subject: glimmer fails to recognize animation prompt
parts:
Hello,

I have a shiny app that utilizes the animation package. When I choose the option "animate pitches" on my local port, it opens another tab with the proper animation deck. However, I just tried out the feature on http://glimmer.rstudio.com/cpsievert/pitchRx/ and it doesn't open another tab. It just outputs a black box on the same page.

I know this question is open ended question, but any advice is greatly appreciated! You can see the source code here: https://github.com/cpsievert/pitchRx/tree/master/inst/shiny

-Carson
